label: The review mode's detect_surface_evidence misroutes generic repositories to the Webflow surface and contradicts the shared detection authority: any changed path containing package.json or src/ returns sk-code:code-webflow, while stack-detection.md:83 says generic Node.js without Webflow markers stays UNKNOWN and names the exact marker set (src/2_javascript/, *.webflow.js, Webflow.push, --vw-, vendor globals, wrangler.toml). Executed proof: text 'fix a null deref in the parser' with changed src/api/client.ts returns sk-code:code-webflow; 'review my dependency bump' with changed package.json returns sk-code:code-webflow. A generic-Node review therefore gets Webflow evidence and skips the unknown-disclosure path. NEW P1.

The review mode has no Obsidian surface anywhere although the hub bundles Obsidian evidence into reviews: detect_surface_evidence has no OBSIDIAN branch, the output contract's surface-evidence line lists only two surfaces plus unknown, and review-core.md describes the field as code-webflow or code-opencode. A case-insensitive rg over SKILL.md, references/ and assets/ exits 1 outside the changelog. The hub's canary case surface-bundle-obsidian expects sk-code-review + sk-code-obsidian, and the shared precedence puts OBSIDIAN above WEBFLOW. Executed proof: 'code review my obsidian plugin' with changed main.ts returns sk-code:unknown. NEW P1.

The review mode still uses pre-rename packet vocabulary in its contracts and guidance: 'use the surface skill (code-webflow / code-opencode)' and 'use code-quality', the report template's 'Baseline used: [sk-code (code-review)]', the sk-code:code-webflow/sk-code:code-opencode keys, and the integration note. The canonical keys are sk-code-webflow, sk-code-opencode, sk-code-quality and sk-code-review. Reproducing case: rg -n 'code-webflow|code-opencode|code-quality' on SKILL.md and review-core.md prints nine rows; none of those keys exists in mode-registry.json. NEW P2.

Verified as already adopted: the round-008 review doctrine fields are present and coherent - Phase 1 reads the connected code and routes unread material to Not checked:, Phase 3 requires a Case: line and cross-group numbering, and the final-line contract states the exact strings with one blank line above the status line. ALREADY-ADOPTED, no action; recorded so later iterations do not re-check doctrine.
